name: Vivo V70 FE x POP MART ZSIGA
desc:
A visual campaign project created for Vivo V70 FE x POP MART ZSIGA, combining playful character storytelling with polished product-focused visuals. The DOPIOUS Team was responsible for developing the visual direction from storyboard planning to 3D composition, rendering, and final image refinement.

Storyboard Design
Developed the visual flow and key scenes to support the product campaign concept.

3D Composite
Created and arranged 3D elements, product visuals, and character-inspired environments into a cohesive commercial composition.

Rendering & Final Touch
Refined lighting, material quality, color tone, and final image details to achieve a polished advertising look.

Short version for website card:
Vivo V70 FE x POP MART ZSIGA
Visual campaign by DOPIOUS Team, covering storyboard design, 3D composite, rendering, and final visual refinement for a playful product-focused advertising concept.

name: KUN JIM DIOSIAM DESSERT SHOP
desc:
The KUN JIM DIOSIAM Dessert Booth is designed to create a premium Thai dessert experience within a compact retail format. The design combines contemporary elegance with traditional Thai identity, transforming the booth into a visually distinctive destination that attracts customers from multiple directions.

The overall concept focuses on presenting authentic Thai desserts through a modern and sophisticated architectural language. Warm wood textures, deep burgundy tones, and gold metallic accents are carefully selected to reflect the richness of Thai culture while maintaining a clean and luxurious appearance suitable for modern shopping malls and exhibition environments.

name: Symphony of ' Misterio Tent '
desc:
Artistry Unveiled: The Mesmeric Design Symphony of 'Misterio Tent'

Step into the enchanting realm of "Misterio Tent," an unfolding masterpiece that marries the swift functionality of a pop-up shop with the timeless allure of Art Deco elegance. This ephemeral installation, designed to be both luxuriously opulent and gracefully foldable, beckons those who seek a momentary escape into a world of wonder and mystery. Join us on a transformative journey through a pop-up experience that transcends the ordinary and embraces the extraordinary.

name: Bangkok Boulevard – Neoclassic House Renovation & Decoration
desc: The interior concept combines neoclassical detailing with contemporary comfort. White marble textures, warm wood flooring, black accent elements, soft fabric textures, and layered lighting are carefully integrated to create a sophisticated yet welcoming home. Each area is designed to feel connected through consistent materials, proportions, and lighting mood, while still allowing every room to have its own character.

name: Bangkok Fashion Week Key Visual
desc: In the avant-garde realm of Bangkok Fashion Week, we present our pièce de résistance—the 3D modeling key visual that seamlessly blends futuristic aesthetics witha unique 3D character. An exploration in mixed media, where fabric intertwines with digital realms, this visual spectacle is a stunning testament to the convergenceof fashion, technology, and artistic innovation.

name: Ganesha for Silpakorn University
desc:
In the realm of digital design, our venture into Ganesha 3D modeling for Silpakorn University emerges as a fusion of art and spirituality. With an unwavering dedication to superlative details and meticulous texture work, we endeavored to transcend the digital medium, crafting a Ganesha that not only captivates the eye but elevates
the spirit, creating a virtual sanctuary that beckons people to prayer.

The Ganesha 3D modeling journey embarked with a commitment to breathe life into the divine. Every contour, every symbolic element was meticulously crafted withan attention to detail that goes beyond the ordinary. The virtual sculpture became a canvas of devotion, each detail a brushstroke in the creation of a digital deity that
captures the essence of Ganesha's sacred presence.

name: Xari Max
desc:
Xari Max: Elevating Elegance in Child Mobility with a Design Tailored for Larger Kids

The collaboration between Dopious and Mimakids is evident in every detail of the Xari Max, where design excellence meets the practical needs of larger kids. The stroller represents a shared commitment to pushing the boundaries of innovation in child mobility. Dopious brings its visionary design philosophy, while Mimakids contributes its deep understanding of child development and safety. The result is a stroller that not only accommodates the size of older children but does so with an elegance that is characteristic of both collaborators.

name: Phra Mae Lakshmi Structure
desc:
In the realm of digital craftsmanship, we proudly present our 3D modeling masterpiece—the Phra Mae Lakshmi Structure. Imbued with superlative details, this
virtual marvel transcends the ordinary, capturing the divine essence of Phra Mae Lakshmi. Join us on a journey where pixels transform into intricacies, and the
virtual structure becomes a tapestry of sacred artistry.

name: Mo’s Family Residence
desc: This residential project was thoughtfully designed for “Mo” and a family with three children, balancing aesthetics, functionality, and budget-conscious construction within an approximate construction budget of 2 million THB. The design embraces a warm contemporary style with natural wood textures, soft daylight, and calm earthy tones to create a home that feels cozy, timeless, and highly livable.

name: Golden Year of New Birth Snake 2025
desc:
Inspired by the symbolism of rebirth, transformation, and prosperity, the installation reinterprets the Year of the Snake through a contemporary sculptural language.
The geometric golden serpent emerges as a monumental centerpiece, blending artisanal elegance with futuristic minimalism — reflecting renewal, wisdom, and the beginning of a new cycle.

name: Naka Charm
desc: Lapis Amument presents the Naka Charm — a symbolic jewelry piece inspired by the legendary Naga, a guardian of protection, prosperity, wisdom, and spiritual strength. Designed as a modern clip-on wrist charm, the piece blends sacred symbolism with a refined minimalist aesthetic, transforming ancient belief into contemporary wearable art.

name: PAWANG Candle Display “Sacred Monolith”
desc:
Designed for PAWANG, this display concept transforms a product presentation into a sculptural spatial experience. Inspired by the timeless beauty of carved stone, sacred architecture, and ceremonial objects, the display was created to elevate each candle holder into a collectible art piece rather than a conventional retail product.

The overall form is composed of layered circular platforms emerging from a monolithic stone base, symbolizing ascension, ritual, and hierarchy. Each level gently guides the viewer’s eye upward, creating a natural visual journey through the collection while giving every product its own sense of importance and presence.

name: SHU DAXIA FOOD CONTAINER
desc: SHU DAXIA is a custom food display tray design project created to elevate the restaurant’s hotpot serving experience. Inspired by traditional Chinese architecture and the strong visual identity of the brand, the product transforms a functional serving tray into a memorable presentation piece.

name: SHU DAXIA FOOD CONTAINER
desc: A luxury studio product rendering for SHU DAXIA Hot Pot, featuring a black-and-gold Chinese mala hot pot on a deep red background with one-directional lighting. The image highlights the ornate dragon details, premium metallic finish, and elegant Chinese dining identity in a clean international visual style.

name: Nike Triple Launch Activation
desc: December Sunday and Dopious collaborated on the comprehensive design, production, and construction of this Nike retail activation at CentralWorld, with Dopious managing the full end-to-end workflow to successfully debut three new performance running models.

name: Self Kiosk Design Concept
desc: Scope: Decembersunday and Dopious+ collaborated on the comprehensive spatial design and conceptual development for the Self brand kiosk, This partnership focused on translating the brand identity into a cohesive retail environment, delivering a complete design solution for the kiosk’s aesthetic and functional layout.

name: Budweiser chiller Design & 3D Modeling
desc: Decembersunday and Dopious+ collaborated on the sculptural design and 3D modeling of an innovative, branded Budweiser display.

name: VARORIOUS ARCADE COVER  DESIGN
desc: Dopious Design developed the exterior cover design for VALOROUS, an interactive arcade shooting game device. The design focuses on creating a strong futuristic identity that makes the machine feel like part of the game world, not only a display device.

name: ZIGI KV
desc:
Compact Design, Global Reach
This Key Visual highlights the Mima Zigi as the perfect go-anywhere, compact stroller. By contrasting the stroller’s minimal footprint with epic global landmarks, the artwork shows that no destination is too big. The central runway and playful explorers represent seamless, effortless travel—proving that with Zigi, exploring the world with your child is easy, light, and limitless.

name: Exoskeleton Assist System for Valorous
desc: This exoskeleton concept is designed for **Valorous**, a game project developed by **MotionX**, with concept design by **Dopious Design**. The design focuses on creating an in-game exoskeleton system that feels both futuristic and believable, based on real product design thinking and realistic mechanical movement.
